questions.stem: A potato cylinder has an initial mass of 4.0 g. After being placed in a sugar solution, its final mass is 3.6 g. What is the percentage change in mass?
questions.explanation: Percentage change = (change in mass / original mass) x 100. The change is 3.6 - 4.0 = -0.4 g. So (-0.4 / 4.0) x 100 = -10%. The negative value shows the potato lost water by osmosis to the more concentrated sugar solution.
